question: Does subtracting bill carry before volatility normalization improve risky-asset selection beyond merely removing BIL from competition?
origin: User requested continuation after the October 16 screen. The hypothesis is informed by that inspected result and is not an independent out-of-sample discovery.

score.remove_bill_control: r_i(126) / sigma_i(63), retaining the original positive raw-momentum gate; BIL cannot receive a target
score.cash_relative_candidate: [r_i(126) - r_BIL(126)] / sigma_i(63); require both raw ETF momentum > 0 and excess momentum > 0; BIL cannot receive a target
score.sigma: same trailing 63-session annualized sample standard deviation of ETF simple adjusted returns; no floor or alternative windows
score.reference: BIL adjusted total-return history is a Treasury-bill-fund proxy with its own fees and price risk, not a certified risk-free rate or the interest paid on idle account cash
score.missing_reference: fail closed; no zero substitution, forward fill, provider lookup or alternate cash proxy
score.role: All 50 supported histories remain inputs; 49 may compete for positions and BIL supplies the reference. BWX/CPER holds remain unchanged. Zero target for BIL is a declared role constraint, not missing coverage.

unchanged: same pinned published October 12 batch, June 2018 warmup, 2021-2024 calibration and 2025+ chronological diagnostic
full first-wave admission, raw-dollar liquidity and duplicate representatives
24 primary classes, parent/child overlap exclusions and deterministic candidate-ID ties
six pooled slots or three classes with two slots each; inverse-volatility sizing, 98% maximum gross and 45% name cap
unfilled budgets stay literal cash, not automatically invested in BIL
monthly anchors plus strict L1 target-change events versus last adopted target, including cash; no held-weight trigger
44 bp cost ceiling and 3x IC/breakeven margin using the original target-weight/raw-return gate; no lowered gate or fitted thresholds

pretest.gate_labels: raw adjusted open-to-open returns on the identical full admissible pool, including zero-weight BIL; preserves comparison with the parent gate
pretest.rank_invariance: Subtracting a common BIL forward return cannot change cross-sectional ranks. Excess-return rank IC must agree with raw-return IC, up to numerical roundoff; it is not a second signal or independent test.
pretest.reference_controls: Both published normalized parent controls with BIL remain frozen reference evidence; matched removal-only controls isolate the actual cash-relative change
pretest.stop: Do not replay a rejected mapping or select a different lookback, class count, threshold or cash reference after results. Report every arm.

diagnostics.signal_and_mapping: On monthly anchors, report raw selection-score IC over eligible risky names separately from final-target mapping IC over all admissible names; no substitution of signal IC into the primary mapping gate
diagnostics.peer_conditioning: Use the inherited primary classes as descriptive conditioning groups. At least three admissible risky names, nonconstant targets/returns and twelve valid months are needed for a class summary; singleton/two-name/short groups are insufficient, not zero IC or inferred comparable peers.
diagnostics.payoff: Static h-session excess contribution versus the BIL proxy: sum_i w_i * [r_i(open_t,open_t+h) - r_BIL(open_t,open_t+h)]. Contrast candidate minus matching removal-only control using identical dates/labels. This is an untraded, zero-cost, BIL-financed comparison, not account PnL or a portfolio backtest.
diagnostics.paired_family: Eight candidate/control contrasts: pooled and class-first at four horizons; report every contrast, no best-horizon selection
diagnostics.uncertainty: Joint stationary bootstrap, 20000 replicates, mean blocks 3/6/12 months, seed 20261017; individual and Bonferroni 95% family intervals. Calibration and later windows separate; conditional inspected-sample diagnostics, not discovery evidence.

prospective.calendar: Dates derived from the application's US calendar; actual exchange closures and missing publications remain explicit, never manufactured sessions
prospective.status: reserved validation design only; no future observations exist in this study and no recurring job is created
prospective.no_early_selection: If a candidate ever qualifies for this stage, freeze it before the first prospective decision and assess once all registered labels mature; do not replace the window or pick a recipe after interim results
prospective.owner: Any future monitored calculation must be implemented in the app strategy/analytics services; agents and reminders cannot perform recurring calculations
prospective.activation: Requires the retrospective gate, full matched economic replay and native parity, reviewed app calculation implementation and separate monitoring/promotion decisions. A failed screen does not activate this reserved window.

replay_if_qualified.controls: same-timing removal-only, same-arm monthly, average-exposure-matched control, original 14-ETF FR25 SOTA and URTH on matched accounting
replay_if_qualified.objective: net Sharpe +0.05 versus matched control, CAGR no more than 0.5pp worse and max drawdown no more than 2pp worse; positive Sharpe advantage at 10bp and one-session delay
replay_if_qualified.required: actual traded turnover/costs, risk/exposure and full constituent/group PnL, chronological and episode stability, family-adjusted inference and native/Python reconciliation; no synthetic-fill exit claims

limitations: Current-survivor first-wave cohort; historical membership, mandate and look-through classifications remain uncertified.
Published adjusted and raw histories are audited with limitations, not certified historical publication vintages or raw trading tape.
Risk-scaled scores do not by themselves make regional, duration, credit and commodity payoffs economically homogeneous; class-conditioned coverage is reported rather than assumed.
This is a finite pre-replay screen. Target-change costs are proxies and exclude actual drift/fills; static forward contribution excludes fees, slippage, timing and portfolio path effects.
Hypothesis and controls are informed by earlier inspected failures; the prospective period is reserved but inactive until a separate eligible implementation exists.
No CNH/FX, macro or direct provider-price input is used. No promotion, funding or execution evidence is supplied by this screen.
